snippet.title: Tiny Bookshop – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Tiny Bookshop is available now on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/tiny-bookshop-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01

Picture this—you leave everything behind and open a cozy bookshop by the sea! Curate your books, decorate your shop, advise customers, and make friends in Tiny Bookshop by Skystone Games & neoludic games.

#TinyBookshop #NintendoSwitch #IndieWorld

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
